claims.claim: Cerberus /file/json/dir accepts POST only; a GET returns HTTP 200 with an empty aaData and an explanatory error key
A POST to /file/json/dir carrying a csrftoken minted before login is rejected with a CSRF error rather than data
Cerberus price files are named <Prefix><ChainId>-<StoreId>-<yyyyMMddHHmm>.gz, not .xml.gz; Rami Levy chain id is 7290058140886
Shufersal and Carrefour price files carry an extra SubChainId segment and split date/time: <Prefix><ChainId>-<SubChainId>-<StoreId>-<yyyyMMdd>-<HHmmss>.gz
Shufersal serves price files as expiring signed Azure Blob URLs listed via FileObject/UpdateCategory, not as stable portal paths
Shufersal and Carrefour PriceFull items use ManufactureName and PriceUpdateTime, where Cerberus feeds use ManufacturerName and PriceUpdateDate
Rami Levy PriceFull uses ItemName for every item; the previously documented ItemNm field does not exist in the feed
Club id is a nested integer at Clubs/ClubId on Cerberus feeds but a flat string beginning with the code on Shufersal feeds
In the Shufersal dialect RewardType, MinQty, MaxQty and DiscountRate sit on PromotionItem inside Groups/Group, not on the Promotion element
Carrefour inlines its file list in the portal HTML with a yyyyMMdd path; downloads resolve at /<path>/<filename> and a wrong filename returns 404
Super-Pharm publishes its price files on its own portal rather than through Cerberus
Good Pharm publishes through the Bina Projects platform rather than through Cerberus
Hazi Hinam serves a full price-file table on its own site
The legacy matrixcatalog.co.il host no longer resolves in DNS as of 2026-08-27
Cerberus serves an individual price file from /file/d/<filename> to an authenticated session; the response is gzipped XML
Cerberus renders the post-login file browser at /file, and that page carries the csrftoken the directory listing requires

claims.claim: For weighted items ItemPrice is priced per the declared UnitOfMeasure, which is not always a kilogram: on a live Carrefour PriceFull 174 of 560 weighted items declared '100 גרם'
Feed files are not reliably UTF-8: a live Carrefour Stores file is UTF-16 little-endian with a BOM and no XML declaration
PriceFull items carry an ItemStatus field that must be checked before treating a row as a live purchasable price
